zh-CN.title: 摄影画板式图片预览
items: 图片预览采用米色摄影画板，相机、曝光、位置与完整拍摄时间按需展示
竖图采用扩展布局，长图可滚动查看，操作集中在右下角

en.title: Photography-style image previews
items: Images use a warm paper layout with camera, exposure, location and full capture time when available
Portraits use an expanded layout, long images scroll, and actions sit at the lower right
